service.description: Write a domain event as a business annotation of the report engine (org.moqui.report.ReportServices create#Annotation, source business), so dashboards over business data show it as a marker on their time series. The owner of the event registers this call to run after its commit (BusinessEvents.js register): a price list published (PriceListPublished, mantle.product.PriceServices.publish#ProductPriceList), a store promotion with a start date (PromotionStart, StorePromotionServices.store#Promotion) and a fiscal period closed (PeriodClosed, mantle.ledger.CloseServices.close#Period). The marker is made from the record as it is stored, never from the caller: its name, its time, its organization and the record's key, and no amount; an event whose record is not in that state (a list not published, a run not closed) or has no organization writes nothing. One event keeps one marker (its key). A failure is logged and answered as not recorded: the owner's change stays.
